# meeting-decisions-actions

Turns the meeting notes you give it into the decisions made and the action items owed, each with an owner and a due date when the notes…

Reads the meeting notes you paste or add and returns two lists: the decisions the meeting made, and the action items that came out of it, each with the owner and due date the notes actually give. Missing owners and dates are written as "not stated" and collected into a follow-up list, never guessed. Returns report.md (or report.json, if you ask for JSON) with the same content as its reply.

Drafted by the Drafter (`agentry draft`). Review the manifest, the instructions and this file before you publish;
this README renders on the BriefAgent's page.
